text.en:
The percentage of net earnings to be declared and remitted b
the NDC as dividends to the National Government, as required under Section 3 of
RA 7656, is authorized to be adjusted downward to 1.0982% or an estimated total
amount of P48.567 Million for 2015.
THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

The adjusted dividend rate set forth in Section 1 is only
applicable to the NDC and the year stated therein.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 7th day of
the vear of our Lord Two Thousand and Seventeen.
By the President:
8 86
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
- 003027
